expected_return.window: scorebord: BUY 13:30 ET on the entry day; SELL amc at the next open, bmo at 13:00 ET on the report day; gross

note: Each member is reported as a percentile of its own live range, 0-100 (pct), with its direction in side; panel_pct (0-100) is the size of the mean of the signed percentiles and side its direction; panel_pct_sd their spread. The selection is panel_pct in the top 20%. panel_score is the signed median of the members' sizes, each read against its own recent history. consensus_k counts members that put the name in their own top 20% on the panel's side; that, not sign agreement, is what selected well on the development names. Certainty (p_up) is recorded and decides nothing. expected_edge_pct is a shrunk in-sample prior, not a forecast. Research only.

opus5.note: A documented sandbagging pattern with consensus pinned at the bottom of the company's own improved guide (Q2 -$0.28 against -$0.50/-$1.00; Q3 -$0.60 against -$0.15/-$0.65), and the two most recent comparables on that exact line were bought +34.3% and +22.5% (i0); the CFO promised the first quantified Catalyst savings number on THIS call while FY consensus sits below the low end of the guide (i2), with a $169.8m cash / no-debt floor under a $132m market cap and an activist director buying at $11.60-12.26 (i3). Q3 seasonality points to a revenue miss (i1) on a line this name has not traded on, and the 43% short cover removes some of the squeeze fuel (i4).

opus55.note: Consensus sits at the bottom of a sandbagged EPS guide the company beat by a wide margin twice (+22%, +34%) (i0). The first quantified Catalyst savings are promised for this call (i2). Below-cash valuation with activist buying (i3). Seasonal revenue risk (i1) is a smaller offset.

sonnet55.note: Consensus EPS -0.60 sits at the bottom of the company's improved guide after two sandbagged beats that moved the stock +34% and +22%; thin $1m/day name with first quantified Catalyst savings due.

fable51.note: Consensus EPS of -0.60 sits at the bottom of the company's own improved -0.15 to -0.65 guide after two consecutive sandbag beats bought +22% and +34% (item 0), the first quantified Catalyst savings number is promised on this call with FY consensus below the guide floor (item 2), and a Steamboat director bought 131k shares at this price on a sub-cash valuation (item 3); the 43% short-interest drop cuts the squeeze fuel, which is why abs_move is 10 and not 20.
